title: docs(skills): four skill pages follow merged code (milestone translations, related-list remedy, kanban cardFooter, action write grant rule)

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuYXH5abZVZ5DkX37q1FSC5P)_

Fixes #37585
Fixes #37899
Fixes #37612
Fixes #37814

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Rule-change: none

## 维护者速读

- 是什么：对外发布的技能包里四处说法补齐到和现在的平台一致：里程碑时间线句子的翻译键、相关列表页签被隐藏后翻译键的改法、看板卡片底部的评论数和附件数、动作脚本缺写入授权时会被校验拦下。只改教 AI 的文字，用户无感。
- 为什么：这四项平台能力这两天已经合入，技能包还没写到，照着技能包干活的 AI 会漏翻译里程碑句子、给出改不好的补救办法、说看板显示不了评论数，或把一条已有检查拦住的错误当成运行时才会出的问题。
- 出错会怎样：只动技能包文字，写错了最多是 AI 学到一句不准的话，可以直接撤回这次修改。
- 要你做的：无，座位复核后交审批人。

## What changes

Four published skill pages, prose and examples only. No code, no eval fixture, no ceiling row.

**`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`** (#37585, #37899 N1)

- The object sub-key table gains a `_milestones.{field}.{value}` row: `summary` is the timeline sentence of the `activityMilestones` entry that fires on that field and value, with the same `{field}` tokens; it is composed at read time in the reader's language, a select token shows as its option label, the stored row is unchanged, and it is redacted as the stored sentence is. Written against `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` (`_milestones`), `resolveObjectMilestoneSummary` and `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-summary-message.ts`.
- The `_relatedLists` row's remedy now reads "re-state the entry, shown, with the owner's own `label`": the lint hint for a hidden entry is "Drop this key, or show the tab (drop `hidden`) with the owner's `label` on the entry" (`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`).

**`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`** (#37899 N1, N2, N3)

- N1: the same remedy wording in the `relatedLists` bullet.
- N2: a bare child name in the `.custom` arrangement, labelled or not, covers each of that child's `child.field` lists too (the migration entry `translation-related-list-key-under-arrangement-refused` and `relatedListNameCovers`).
- N3: the import clause names the third `reference_not_found` arm, a scoping field the engine cannot filter by, such as a formula (`import_reference_scope_unqueryable` in `packages/core/src/utils/import-coerce.ts`).

**`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`** (#37612)

- The kanban example carries `cardFooter: { comments: true, attachments: true }`, and the notes under it say: those two members only, `comments` counts the record's open top-level threads, `attachments` its files, shown only with `enable.files` on the object. Written against `KanbanConfigSchema.cardFooter` (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, a strict object) and `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx` (the attachment count is read only when `objectDef.enable.files === true`).

**`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`** (#37814)

- The opening paragraph said that without `capabilities: ['api.write']` "the sandbox throws on a write". It now names the rule that refuses it, `action-body-write-capability-undeclared`, beside the two rule ids the paragraph already names.
- The card's second item, checked: this skill teaches no seed key, and the object-binding trap is already named by its rule (`action-no-object-binding`) in the same paragraph. Nothing else moves here.

**Paid for in the same file (token ratchet, no ceiling moves).**

| File | Cut | Where it still lives |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` | from the bundle example: the `due_date` field (both locales), `common.cancel` (both locales), the zh-CN `apps` block; from the interpolation example: the `pagination` message | the example keeps `subject` and `status`, `common.save` and `welcome.user`, the `en` `apps` block (the zh-CN one is "same shape, translated values"), and the `welcome` message with its double-brace hole |
| `relationships.md` | `first_name` in the lookup example, `product` in the master-detail example, the aside "(e.g. `primary_account` + `partner_account`)" | neither field is a relationship; the sentence "several FKs yields one related list per FK" stays |
| `list-views.md` | "Bare-key blocks in this file are fragments, so `check:skill-examples` skips them."; two Airtable asides; the `due_date` column object folded to one line; alignment padding in the gantt example's comments | the first is a note to this repository's maintainers, not to a skill reader; the rest keep every key and comment |
| `actions.md` | "(a constant is a style, not a reader's state)" after "a boolean literal is refused" | the refusal itself stays |

Decided in the thread (small, listed per the standing rule):

- The N2 sentence lives in `relationships.md` only; the i18n row points there already (**objectstack-data**), and the row had no room for it.
- No eval case is added and no eval round ran (the dispatch order says none). No `Skills-docs:` line: the kind is `none` and there is no `(narrowing)` arm, so none is owed, and no eval exercises the new sentences.
- `Rule-change: none` is written at the seat's request; the diff touches no `.claude/**` path.
- The merge queue removed head `8b452b4f` on 2026-11-27: `main` had meanwhile shortened `actions.md` and lowered its row from 3890 to 3844 (and moved `list-views.md` to 4510), so on the merge commit `actions.md` measured 3843, one under its ceiling, and the token ratchet was red (`Type Check · source gates`, run 46042274398). `main` @ `cb3f8b95` is merged in and the new `actions.md` sentence gained two bytes ("without that grant, a write is refused too"), so the file sits at 3844. No ceiling row is edited here.
- Branch name: the platform assigned `claude/project-thread-s5bvax`, so it does not carry an issue number.

## Why

Each behaviour has merged, and each code PR left the skill text as a follow-up because `skills/**` is governed. Until the pages change, an agent that writes a translation bundle from the skill leaves milestone sentences untranslated, one that fixes a refused related-list key re-states a label on an entry that stays hidden, one asked for comment counts on a board finds no key, and one that reads the actions page takes a refused write for a run-time failure.

## Tests

Prose and examples only, so no unit test changes and no ablation.

Local gates, run on head `8b452b4f` (before the merge of `main`) after a full `pnpm build` (verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 50 families for this diff, all 50 ran with exit 0, and `--ran` answers:

Everything else is CI's run: the check-runs on this PR are the record.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise re-read on `main` @ `4af32b99` before writing: all four passages still carried the old text, and every prerequisite is merged (`_milestones` in the translation schema, `cardFooter` in `KanbanConfigSchema`, the rule `action-body-write-capability-undeclared` in `packages/lint`, the migration entry for the related-list key).
- Noted, not filed: no published skill names `seed-record-unknown-field` or `object-reference-unknown`; #37814 asks about `objectstack-ui` only. The seat has read `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md`: it does not teach the `seed-record-unknown-field` trap as prose, so no card is needed.
- Milestone templates use single-brace `{field}` tokens, while `messages` use double braces. The new row says "`{field}` tokens"; the interpolation section's sentence about double braces is about `messages` and is unchanged.

## Verification

Read first: the `_milestones` row of `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, then the kanban example and note in `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`, then the `relatedLists` bullet of `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`. The risk hunk is the shortened bundle example in the i18n page.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` prints the four files at their ceilings with headroom 0.

Tier H: `skills/**`. Contract review at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER is owed by the seat; not self-reviewed here.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's run.
- [x] 4. One branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request (four folded cards, per the claim).
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
